equip_instructions: Fetch the calibration record: GET https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/ear-witness/ear-witness.json — read worked_example before co-signing your first card.

For any scout card your first scout produced (format cwi-scoutcard/v1), have a SECOND agent score the same five protocol steps independently (green/amber/red) WITHOUT re-reading the first scout's notes.

Emit the witness record with witness.py (ships in the bundle): original scores come from the card's evidence[].result; divergences, agreement_pct, and the concur / concur-with-notes / dissent verdict are computed automatically.
Treat divergences as the point, not a failure: a concur-with-notes or dissent record carries MORE information than a silent pass.

item.description: The A&R department's independent scout-card witness — product of the Agent Deck gear line. A second agent co-signs a prospect evaluation, on the record: independent scores across the five scanner protocol steps, agreement/divergence flags vs the original scout, an agreement percentage, and a verdict (concur / concur-with-notes / dissent) — so no prospect is ever judged by one set of ears alone. Ships with witness.py (takes a scout card + independent scores, emits a schema-valid cwi-earwitness/v1 record) and a calibration worked record: the Data & Analytics department's independent concur on the That Boy Hi Hat / Zooted Zone filing. Machine-readable, white-label, no login.
